_about: Cross-check v2 (25 Nov 2026), after the engineers said the should-cost is above what is paid. Rule: the LOWEST price read on a page from the maker, a franchised distributor, or a China distributor's own stock (brokers / partner stock excluded); a topic with no page-read price is unchanged and listed as unverified. Research: scratchpad edu-xcheck/{components,bare-pcb,ems-conversion}.json. FX £1 = $1.27 = ¥8.8799; szlcsc prices ÷ 1.13 to remove 13 % VAT (recoverable by a China EMS).

board.note: Chaoying (超颖) prospectus: 4–6-layer boards, mainly automotive (68.6 % automotive, IATF 16949; customers Continental, Valeo, Bosch), 2024 ASP ¥995.31/m² (revenue ¥1,610.98 m ÷ 161.86 万 m²); rolled to 2026 by the +12–17 % automotive PCB price rise reported by Sina (17 Sep 2026) → ¥1,115–1,165; the top of that band is taken for a 6-layer board in a 4/6-layer mix. Class-3 extras PCBasic: 25 µm hole copper +¥25/m², 4-wire test +¥80/m². ASP is per m² sold, so drilling at normal density (PCBasic: included up to 100,000 holes/m²; ours 53,000), ENIG, utilisation and the automotive premium are inside it. Cross-check: Olympic (世运) all boards ¥1,043/m², Kinwong ¥1,114/m² (2024).
